Four siblings. Same hundred euros a month. Twenty years later, one is way ahead.
Guess which one. Number one hides it under her bed.
Number two spends it. Pizza, games, sneakers.
Number three uses a savings account. About two percent.
Number four picks a broad index fund. Assumed six percent.

text: Twenty years later... number two has zero.

Number one has twenty four thousand. After inflation, that buys what sixteen thousand buys today.
Number three has about twenty nine and a half thousand.

text: Number four? About forty six thousand. Almost double what she put in.

Funds go up and down. Nothing's guaranteed. But time did the work.

text: Which sibling are you? One, two, three or four?
